features.quote: Turn budget: 14 turns (longer because each step takes a turn)
Budgets are set to be long enough that degradation can develop (you need at least 5–6 turns) but short enough that token costs are manageable.
features.justification_quote: short enough that token costs are manageable

features.quote: Drop tasks where pilot trigger rate < 15% (not producing degradation reliably enough) or > 95% (ceiling effect, not discriminative).
features.justification_quote: not producing degradation reliably enough … ceiling effect, not discriminative
